output.review_comment: The PR contains undocumented, test-specific logic that contradicts the docstring. The "Special Handling for Half-Hour Days" (lines 48-51) is implemented only to satisfy test_overtime_half_hour and lacks any business justification or documentation. The rule—that 30-minute fractional parts are counted at 60% when daily minutes exceed 480—is opaque and brittle without understanding the actual payroll specification. Before merging, either: (1) update the docstring and add explanatory comments about the business rule, or (2) ask the teammate to clarify what this rule represents, since it appears to contradict the documented time calculation logic.
